newsitem.title: UK: NatWest holds top spot in Reuters UK research poll.
newsitem.headline: NatWest holds top spot in Reuters UK research poll.

text.p: NatWest Securities held on to top spot in the annual Reuters poll of larger UK company investment research published on Tuesday, but its lead slipped after a year which saw considerable turnover of staff.

NatWest received 13.33 percent of votes in the weighted survey of fund managers compiled by Tempest Consulting, down from 14.97 percent in the 1996 poll. SBC Warburg was second on 12.75 percent with HSBC James Capel third on 11.52 percent.

The poll showed strong concentration on the top eight houses -- Natwest, SBC Warburg, HSBC James Capel, UBS, BZW, Merrill Lynch, Dresdner Kleinwort Benson and ABN-AMRO Hoare Govett -- with Cazenove & Co in ninth place garnering just 1.53 percent of votes.
Finance directors polled placed UBS in top spot with 12.89 percent of votes, ahead of NatWest in second place and Merrill Lynch in third.
The NatWest oil team led by Fergus MacLeod was again voted best sector team.
SBC Warburg won awards for both best broker execution and best broker sales.
Finance directors voted Mercury Asset Management as best fund management group and the team at Schoder Investment Management as best individual fund manager.
